result.summary: The main visual defect is an untranslated localization key ('home_feed.popular_title') shown as a section heading. Other minor issues include truncated content at the right edge of horizontal carousels, which is expected behavior but one restaurant name is cut off mid-word.

issues.description: Raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' is displayed instead of a translated section title (e.g., 'Popular near you'), indicating a missing or failed string lookup.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for this key in the localization files and provide a sensible fallback (e.g., English default) when a key is not found.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is clipped at the screen edge without an ellipsis or clear truncation treatment.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with ellipsis inside the card bounds, or add right padding/peek spacing so partially visible cards clearly indicate scrollable content.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off on the right with a partially visible chip after 'Healthy', with no visual affordance (fade/gradient) indicating more chips are scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or edge peek styling on the chip row to signal horizontal scrollability.
